title: Negotiated anchor-credit model and rolling true‑up playbook for expansion surges
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket defines an experiment and operational playbook for offering 'anchor credits' (negotiated upfront credits that act as an expansion accelerator) paired with an automated rolling true‑up ledger for multi-year contracts. Goal: increase net revenue retention (NRR) and conversion velocity for prospects that cite procurement/security friction, while preserving unit economics and reducing manual reconciliation load for RevOps. The deliverable includes pricing bands, ledger rules, legal clause templates, Security Questionnaire (SQ) triggers, playbook runbooks for Renewals & AMs, and telemetry requirements for evaluation.
objectives: Increase NRR among pilot cohort by 8-12% over 12 months
Reduce manual true-up reconciliation time per account by 60%
Improve trial-to-commit conversion velocity for midmarket by 20%
Ensure SQ responses auto-map to contract language and don't add >7 business days to procurement
experiment_design: Cohort A (pilot): anchor credit = 8% of first-year commit applied as expansion buffer; rolling true-up runs quarterly with auto-offset rules. Cohort B (control): standard commit bands + manual annual true-up. Randomized at renewal opportunity for 120 midmarket customers. Metrics: expansion ARR, churn, time-to-sign, RevOps manual hours, dispute rate.
operational_components: Anchor credit booking and amortization rules
Rolling true-up ledger (quarterly, auto-offset, dispute window)
Contract clause templates for anchor credits and Q-true-ups
SQ trigger mapping and Pre-approved answers to common security Qs
RevOps dashboard and automated reconciliation exports
legal_and_security_notes: Legal has pre-approved a limited anchor-credit clause for pilot (see attachment). Security team requires SQ mapping for three high-frequency questions: data residency, encryption-at-rest (KMS), and SOC/audit artifacts — answers must be reflected in contract addendum. If customer requires non-standard SQ responses, manual SSO review required and ticket to security-bucket.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Anchor credits drive poor unit economics if expansions don't materialize. Mitigation: limit pilot to committed cohorts with usage baselines and phased anchor release tied to usage thresholds.
Risk: SQ edge cases delay sign-off. Mitigation: pre-authorized SQ answer set and fast-path escalation to Security for exceptions.
Risk: Accounting complexity for amortization. Mitigation: Finance-approved amortization tables and automated ledger exports for reconciliation.
